summary.works: ODS sheets exceeding the whole reader stream in bounded row windows; cards offer known sheet names.
summary.inputs: Home Office hospitality ODS (good); LibreOffice fdo43534test ODS (difficult), both test_only.
summary.gaps: Full Studio suite unqualified on this host; live intake/placement rehearsal remains.

changes: Resumed and reviewed all 13 uncommitted files; retained the implementation and corrected its defects.
read_workbook_windows.py streams content.xml with expat and builds only one selected-sheet row at a time.
native_ods.py shares package and stored-cell interpretation helpers between whole and stream readers.
Repeated rows/columns expand exactly; empty trailing padding writes no records; formulas are never evaluated.
Windows flush before the byte ceiling; raw row XML and serialized records both respect the record ceiling.
readOdsWindows promotes byte/cell/row bounds to the existing workbook stream, using private scratch.
TABULAR_ODS_LIMIT now means an ODS repeat/cell bound the stream also cannot take, not a whole-read overflow.
All case-original ODS raw jobs use windows, including small compressed packages beyond the whole cell bound.
The bounded content.xml head inventories real table starts; comments/CDATA cannot invent sheet names.
Incomplete inventories say at least; unsupported namespace/encoding metadata profiles leave names absent.
Studio ODS sheet items resolve their parent original; obsolete 16 MiB refusal words and forecast removed.
Window contracts carry paired rowElement/rowSha256 fields; OpenAPI, source pins and client types regenerated.

locators.sourceRow: Expanded physical row number within the chosen sheet, including skipped empty rows.
locators.byteStartByteEndSha256: Stored content.xml ZIP-member range and hash, not a fictitious row byte range.
locators.sheetSha256: SHA-256 of uncompressed content.xml, which holds all sheets.
locators.rowElement: One-based row-element ordinal within the chosen sheet, before expanding repetitions.
locators.rowSha256: SHA-256 of that element's exact XML bytes, including its start/end tags; not reserialization.
locators.repetitions: Repeated records share rowElement/rowSha256 but retain distinct sourceRow values.
locators.encodings: Exact row hashes checked across a 1 MiB parser boundary and UTF-16LE/BE originals.

controls.job: 2500-row small ODS: queued profile job -> stored raw window -> schema-valid rows page with row hashes.
